entry.title: Petit Cazadores Reserva
entry.summaryHtml: Black pepper, cocoa, leather, earth, dark coffee and restrained sweetness come through with unusual concentration for a 4″ × 40 cigar. The Connecticut Broadleaf wrapper carries a large share of the flavour in this small format, giving the smoke a dense, spicy start that settles into darker coffee, cocoa and leather.
entry.noteHtml: The broad wrapper-to-filler ratio makes this a concentrated little Broadleaf cigar rather than a mild quick smoke. Reviews are consistently positive on flavour, but firm or tight draws recur often enough to justify a Yellow construction-risk flag.
productionLines: Handmade in Nicaragua by My Father Cigars
